review.notes: All 14 physical PDF pages' extracted text was block-compared against the OCR markdown after whitespace/punctuation normalization; no dropped blocks, headings or reference entries found. Physical page 11 was rendered at 150 dpi and visually checked: Tables 7-8 print ballot X (U+2717) for sparse attention off and a check mark (U+2713) for on; OCR misread the cross as U+2715 in Table 7 and all four check marks as the square-root sign U+221A. Table 8's four ballot-X glyphs were read correctly. Source-printed quirks kept: 'Data Volumn' header typo, 'Equally Bad'/'Equally good' and 'Other better'/'other better' case inconsistency, and the truncated-looking sentence 'combining a general textual encoder.' in the Text encoder paragraph all match the PDF text layer exactly. Algorithm 1 block (physical p.5) has no fences and its math delimiters render; citation punctuation spacing after inline math is handled by the shared normalizer.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.11 Table 7 (visually checked at 150 dpi) prints the ballot X glyph U+2717 in the Sparse Attention column of rows 1, 2, 3 and 5; the PDF text layer also extracts U+2717. OCR misread all four as the multiplication X U+2715. Table 8's identical glyphs on the same page were read correctly as U+2717.

Rendered physical p.11 Tables 7-8 (visually checked at 150 dpi) print a check mark U+2713 in the Sparse Attention column of the two sparse-attention-enabled rows of each table; the PDF text layer also extracts U+2713. OCR misread all four as the square-root sign U+221A.
